sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com进行部分采访的直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: When a judge ordered the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当法官下令美国

sentences.en: government to reunite the 2,600 children and parents it had separated at the border, the government claimed it would be nearly impossible to do.
sentences.zh: 政府让在边境拆散的2600名儿童与父母团聚时，政府声称这几乎是不可能做到的。

sentences.en: In part two of our series, my colleagues Caitlin Dickerson and Annie Correal tell the story of why the government could separate the families, but not reunite them.
sentences.zh: 在我们系列报道的第二部分中，我的同事凯特琳·迪克森和安妮·科雷尔讲述了政府为何能拆散这些家庭，却无法让他们团聚的故事。

sentences.en: Friday, August 24th.
sentences.zh: 8月24日，星期五。

sentences.en: Breaking news out of San Diego where a judge has ordered border authorities to reunite separated migrant families within 30 days.
sentences.zh: 圣地亚哥突发新闻，一名法官已下令边境当局在30天内让被拆散的移民家庭团聚。

sentences.en: Overnight, a judge in California ordering the Trump administration to reunite all children with their families within 30 days.
sentences.zh: 昨夜，加利福尼亚州的一名法官下令特朗普政府在30天内让所有儿童与家人团聚。

sentences.en: The talk is ticking and here on the ground organizations and lawyers are telling us they're not seeing very much movement.
sentences.zh: 时间紧迫，而我们在现场了解到，相关组织和律师表示并没有看到太大的进展。

sentences.en: Tonight, more chaos in the controversy over separating families at the border.
sentences.zh: 今晚，关于边境家庭拆散问题的争议中出现了更多的混乱。

sentences.en: The Trump administration now admits it needs more time to meet the court order deadline for those families to be reunited.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府现在承认，需要更多时间来满足法院规定的家庭团聚截止日期。

sentences.en: Today is the court order deadline for children under five to be reunited with their parents.
sentences.zh: 今天是法院规定的五岁以下儿童与父母团聚的截止日期。

sentences.en: It is a deadline the United States government will not meet.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美国政府无法满足的最后期限。

sentences.en: Change, change, change, change, change, change.
sentences.zh: 改变，改变，改变，改变，改变，改变。

sentences.en: The judge was very clear today.
sentences.zh: 法官今天说得很清楚。

sentences.en: These deadlines are firm.
sentences.zh: 这些截止日期是严格的。

sentences.en: The government has to follow them unless they have a good reason not to reunite.
sentences.zh: 政府必须遵守这些规定，除非他们有充分的理由不让家庭团聚。

sentences.en: Keep families together.
sentences.zh: 让家庭团聚。

sentences.en: Keep families together.
sentences.zh: 让家庭团聚。

sentences.en: The government acknowledged it hadn't even figured out who the parents are in some cases, much less actually bringing them back together.
sentences.zh: 政府承认，在某些情况下，他们甚至还没弄清楚谁是父母，更不用说让他们真正团聚了。

sentences.en: So here we are after one executive order, two deadlines, an unprecedented sprint to undo the work of this policy.
sentences.zh: 所以，在经历了一项行政命令、两个截止日期以及一场旨在撤销该政策影响的前所未有的冲刺之后，我们来到了这里。

sentences.en: Technically, the government manages to hit its final deadline and reunify all these kids were eligible.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，政府设法赶上了最终期限，并让所有符合条件的儿童实现了团聚。

sentences.en: But we still have hundreds of kids whose parents were deported without them and others who, for various reasons, are still in limbo.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍有数百名儿童的父母在没有他们的情况下被驱逐出境，还有一些人因各种原因仍处于悬而未决的状态。

sentences.en: So this is far from over.
sentences.zh: 所以这件事远未结束。

sentences.en: And there are no real consequences for that.
sentences.zh: 而且对此并没有真正的后果。

sentences.en: The ACLU proposes ideas to the judge, like creating a fund to pay for mental health care for the families, but he still hasn't ruled on that.
sentences.zh: 美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）向法官提出了建议，比如设立基金为这些家庭支付心理健康护理费用，但他尚未对此作出裁决。

sentences.en: So the government has yet to answer, really, for failing to reunify all these families, let alone separating them in the first place.
sentences.zh: 因此，政府实际上还没有为未能让所有这些家庭团聚负责，更不用说最初拆散他们的问题了。

sentences.en: And all along, people have been asking, why was this such a mess?
sentences.zh: 一直以来，人们都在问，为什么会搞得这么乱？

sentences.en: Because it's confusing.
sentences.zh: 因为这太令人困惑了。

sentences.en: How could it have been so difficult to undo this work of separation?
sentences.zh: 撤销这项拆散政策的工作怎么会如此困难？

sentences.en: And I find out that there's a pretty clear answer.
sentences.zh: 我发现有一个非常明确的答案。

sentences.en: So when someone crosses the border, they're processed by border agents.
sentences.zh: 当有人越过边境时，他们会由边境特工进行处理。

sentences.en: They're put into a computer system, they're put into a computer system, and the agent chooses from a drop-down menu to essentially characterize that person.
sentences.zh: 他们被录入计算机系统，特工从下拉菜单中选择选项，本质上是对那个人进行定性。

sentences.en: So they can be characterized as an unaccompanied minor, if it's a child who came in on its own.
sentences.zh: 如果是一个独自前来的儿童，他们可以被定性为无人陪伴的未成年人。

sentences.en: They can be characterized as an individual adult, if that's the case.
sentences.zh: 如果是成年人，他们可以被定性为个人成年人。

sentences.en: Or they can be characterized as AWC, adult with children, if it's a family.
sentences.zh: 或者如果是家庭，他们可以被定性为AWC，即带孩子的成年人。

sentences.en: And when a border agent chooses that category in the computer, it creates automatically an identification number for that family unit that goes into the
sentences.zh: 当边境特工在计算机中选择该类别时，它会自动为该家庭单位创建一个识别号码，并进入

sentences.en: immigration files of each member.
sentences.zh: 每个成员的移民档案中。

sentences.en: And that number can be used to track them at any given time moving forward.
sentences.zh: 这个号码可以在未来任何时候用来追踪他们。

sentences.en: This was the protocol for years.
sentences.zh: 这是多年来的协议。

sentences.en: This is the way people were always dealt with when they crossed the border.
sentences.zh: 这就是人们越过边境时一直以来的处理方式。

sentences.en: When family separation started, border agents started doing things differently.
sentences.zh: 当家庭拆散开始时，边境特工开始采取不同的做法。

sentences.en: They would process families as AWC, adults with children.
sentences.zh: 他们会以AWC（带孩子的成年人）处理家庭。

sentences.en: But then when it came time to separate them, which usually happened after a couple days, they would change the family's immigration records.
sentences.zh: 但当需要拆散他们时（通常在几天后发生），他们会更改家庭的移民记录。

sentences.en: And they would characterize the kids as unaccompanied minors and the adults as individual adults.
sentences.zh: 他们会将儿童定性为无人陪伴的未成年人，将成年人定性为个人成年人。

sentences.en: So added into this category of unaccompanied minors, which is usually teenagers crossing the border on their own, are these babies and toddlers.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个通常指独自越境的青少年的“无人陪伴未成年人”类别中，加入了这些婴儿和幼儿。

sentences.en: They also become unaccompanied minors.
sentences.zh: 他们也变成了无人陪伴的未成年人。

sentences.en: And by moving the little kids into this category of unaccompanied minor and moving their
sentences.zh: 通过将小孩移入“无人陪伴未成年人”类别，并将他们的

sentences.en: parents into the category of adults, that change deleted the family identification number from their records.
sentences.zh: 父母移入“成年人”类别，这一更改删除了他们记录中的家庭识别号码。

sentences.en: So you could no longer link family members together, essentially deleting the family unit from government computers.
sentences.zh: 因此，你无法再将家庭成员联系在一起，本质上是从政府计算机中删除了家庭单位。

sentences.en: So when people hear this, they immediately picture something sinister.
sentences.zh: 所以当人们听到这个消息时，他们立刻会想到一些险恶的事情。

sentences.en: They think border agents carrying out this policy were essentially trying to cover their
sentences.zh: 他们认为执行这项政策的边境特工本质上是试图掩盖他们的

sentences.en: tracks or intentionally make it impossible to link parents and kids after they were separated.
sentences.zh: 行踪，或者故意让父母和孩子在被拆散后无法建立联系。

sentences.en: But the officials who told us this were very quick to make clear this is not what was happening.
sentences.zh: 但告诉我们这些的官员很快澄清，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: You can think of border agents as essentially cops or frontline workers who are working along the border and carrying out orders from above.
sentences.zh: 你可以把边境特工看作是本质上的警察或一线工作人员，他们在边境工作并执行上级的命令。

sentences.en: So they're not making policy.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不是在制定政策。

sentences.en: They can't change their computer systems in a way that would separate families but still hold on to that identification number, for example.
sentences.zh: 他们无法以一种既能拆散家庭又能保留识别号码的方式更改计算机系统。

sentences.en: They just don't have that much power on an individual level.
sentences.zh: 他们在个人层面上并没有那么大的权力。

sentences.en: But there is someone who had that power.
sentences.zh: 但确实有人拥有那种权力。

sentences.en: Well, good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: It is my pleasure to be here because I would love to see if I can help explain some of what's going on and give you some of the facts.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴来到这里，因为我很乐意看看能否帮助解释正在发生的一些事情，并提供一些事实。

sentences.en: I know there have been a lot put out there, but hopefully we can clarify some things today.
sentences.zh: 我知道外界有很多说法，但希望我们今天能澄清一些事情。

sentences.en: Secretary Nielsen, for one, and other high-ranking officials within DHS or within the Border Patrol, and they didn't use it.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森部长以及国土安全部或边境巡逻队内部的其他高级官员，他们并没有使用它。

sentences.en: They didn't say, OK, here's how we're going to separate families in a way that still makes sure we can figure out where they are so that we can reconnect them at some point.
sentences.zh: 他们没有说：“好吧，我们要以一种既能拆散家庭，又能确保我们能找到他们位置，以便在某个时候让他们团聚的方式来做。”

sentences.en: And finally, DHS is not separating families, legitimately seeking asylum at ports of entry.
sentences.zh: 最后，国土安全部并没有拆散在入境口岸合法寻求庇护的家庭。

sentences.en: And there's a reason this didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 这件事没有发生是有原因的。

sentences.en: Remember, this is happening at a time when
sentences.zh: 记住，这发生在一个

sentences.en: Secretary Nielsen is telling Congress and telling the public, we don't have a family separation policy.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森部长告诉国会和公众“我们没有家庭拆散政策”的时候。

sentences.en: It's not a policy.
sentences.zh: 这不是一项政策。

sentences.en: Our policy at DHS is to do what we're sworn to do, which is to enforce the law.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部的政策是做我们宣誓要做的事，即执行法律。

sentences.en: We do not have a family separation policy, essentially saying we're not doing this.
sentences.zh: 我们没有家庭拆散政策，本质上是说我们没有在做这件事。

sentences.en: And I want to correct the record.
sentences.zh: 我想纠正一下记录。

sentences.en: Here are the facts.
sentences.zh: 事实如下。

sentences.en: First, this administration did not create a policy of separating families at the border.
sentences.zh: 首先，本届政府并没有制定在边境拆散家庭的政策。

sentences.en: We have a statutory responsibility that we take seriously to protect alien children
sentences.zh: 我们有法定的责任，我们认真对待，以保护外籍儿童

sentences.en: from human smuggling, trafficking, and other criminal actions while enforcing our immigration laws.
sentences.zh: 免受人口走私、贩运和其他犯罪行为的侵害，同时执行我们的移民法。

sentences.en: So she couldn't very well turn around and send out a memo to her agency with instructions for how to
sentences.zh: 所以她不能转过身去给她的机构发一份备忘录，说明如何

sentences.en: carry out family separations in a thoughtful or organized way, because that would have required acknowledging family separations.
sentences.zh: 以一种深思熟虑或有组织的方式执行家庭拆散，因为那将需要承认家庭拆散的存在。

sentences.en: And she wasn't going to do that.
sentences.zh: 而她并不打算那样做。

sentences.en: So there was a vacuum.
sentences.zh: 所以出现了一个真空。

sentences.en: There was no guidance.
sentences.zh: 没有指导。

sentences.en: There were no instructions.
sentences.zh: 没有说明。

sentences.en: And that left people on the ground to figure out for themselves how they were going to do this.
sentences.zh: 这让现场的人们只能自己想办法去执行。

sentences.en: And that's how we got to this point where we had thousands of children and thousands of parents strewn across the country.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们走到这一步的原因，成千上万的儿童和父母散落在全国各地。

sentences.en: And in many cases, no way to connect them except for their word.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，除了他们的一面之词，没有办法将他们联系起来。

sentences.en: We return to immigration and the complicated process of reuniting children and parents who were forcibly separated at the border.
sentences.zh: 我们回到移民问题，以及让在边境被强行拆散的儿童和父母团聚的复杂过程。

sentences.en: Where exactly is the system falling down?
sentences.zh: 系统到底在哪里出了问题？

sentences.en: It should not be a problem to find the child in the ORR system.
sentences.zh: 在难民安置办公室（ORR）系统中找到孩子不应该是个问题。

sentences.en: We feel like it's forcing a crisis on top of a crisis that already existed.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得这是在现有的危机之上又强加了一场危机。

sentences.en: So when you try to reunify people in that situation, you have to start from scratch.
sentences.zh: 所以当你试图让处于这种情况的人团聚时，你必须从零开始。

sentences.en: So we have this judge demanding week after week that the government lawyers explain, you know, why they're taking so long.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有这位法官每周都要求政府律师解释，你知道，为什么他们花了这么长时间。

sentences.en: And the answer is because matching these parents and children had to be done manually.
sentences.zh: 答案是，因为匹配这些父母和孩子必须手动完成。

sentences.en: There was no database that showed who belonged to who.
sentences.zh: 没有任何数据库显示谁属于谁。

sentences.en: So when they separated them, there was no thought of how to reunify them, how to bring them back together at the end of this process?
sentences.zh: 所以当他们拆散他们时，根本没有考虑过如何让他们团聚，如何在这个过程结束时让他们重新在一起？

sentences.en: Absolutely none.
sentences.zh: 完全没有。

sentences.en: And of course, you've got various...
sentences.zh: 当然，你还有各种……

sentences.en: Each record had to be scrubbed by hand.
sentences.zh: 每条记录都必须手工清理。

sentences.en: And then after a match was identified, it had to be checked with background investigations and DNA testing and interviews to prove these really were families.
sentences.zh: 然后在确定匹配后，必须通过背景调查、DNA测试和采访来证明这些确实是家庭。

sentences.en: This was a policy that was implemented with no thought given to how do you reunify families?
sentences.zh: 这是一项在实施时根本没有考虑如何让家庭团聚的政策。

sentences.en: How do you allow them to communicate?
sentences.zh: 你如何让他们沟通？

sentences.en: In the end, moving around thousands of people in custody, many of whom are kids, was never going to be easy.
sentences.zh: 最后，转移数千名被拘留的人（其中许多是儿童）从来都不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: But the level of chaos and scramble and the mistakes that we saw during this reunification effort were totally avoidable.
sentences.zh: 但我们在这次团聚努力中看到的混乱、仓促和错误是完全可以避免的。

sentences.en: They were the result of a problem the government created when it chose not to track these families that were broken apart.
sentences.zh: 它们是政府选择不追踪这些被拆散家庭时所制造的问题的结果。

sentences.en: And with that, I'll take some questions.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在我来回答一些问题。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Secretary Nielsen, if you could, what you talked about there, DHS is no longer ignoring the law.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森部长，如果你愿意的话，关于你刚才谈到的，国土安全部不再无视法律。

sentences.en: You're calling on Congress to change the law.
sentences.zh: 你呼吁国会修改法律。

sentences.en: I mean, that is the big message here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是这里传达的主要信息。

sentences.en: Members of Congress on the Democratic side say that you are using children as a lever to try to get them to take legislative action.
sentences.zh: 民主党方面的国会议员说，你正在利用儿童作为筹码，试图让他们采取立法行动。

sentences.en: What do you say?
sentences.zh: 你怎么说？

sentences.en: I say that is a very cowardly response.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种非常懦弱的回应。

sentences.en: It's clearly within their power to make the laws.
sentences.zh: 制定法律显然在他们的权力范围内。

sentences.en: At this point, we've talked to people at each level of government, from the agents who deleted the records to people in the highest tiers who were giving out orders.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，我们已经与政府各级人员谈过，从删除记录的特工到发布命令的最高层人员。

sentences.en: For the border agents who did the separations, my colleague Ron Nixon talked to a handful,
sentences.zh: 对于执行拆散任务的边境特工，我的同事罗恩·尼克松采访了几个，

sentences.en: and some of them said, look, when a cop pulls over a car and learns that there's an outstanding warrant for the person who's driving, they have to arrest that person,
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人说，看，当警察拦下一辆车并得知驾驶员有未决逮捕令时，他们必须逮捕那个人，

sentences.en: even if they feel bad because there's a five-year-old crying in the back seat.
sentences.zh: 即使他们因为后座有个五岁的孩子在哭而感到难过。

sentences.en: They have to enforce the law.
sentences.zh: 他们必须执行法律。

sentences.en: Other agents actually felt like they were protecting the kids because they felt parents had been so irresponsible in bringing them on this dangerous journey that they were actually
sentences.zh: 其他特工实际上觉得他们是在保护孩子，因为他们觉得父母在带他们进行这段危险旅程时太不负责任了，以至于他们实际上

sentences.en: unfit to take care of children.
sentences.zh: 不适合照顾孩子。

sentences.en: When we go through the official channels and ask DHS about the specifics of family separation, to this day, a lot of what I get is denial.
sentences.zh: 当我们通过官方渠道询问国土安全部关于家庭拆散的具体细节时，直到今天，我得到的很多回应都是否认。

sentences.en: When I asked them about this description we got, for example, of how records were deleted at the border, they disputed it for my story.
sentences.zh: 当我问他们关于我们得到的描述（例如边境记录是如何被删除的）时，他们为我的报道提出了异议。

sentences.en: But since then, the Health and Human Services Department has confirmed that it's true.
sentences.zh: 但从那以后，卫生与公众服务部已经证实这是真的。

sentences.en: Can we say, are the children being used as pawns against a four-wall?
sentences.zh: 我们能说，孩子们被当作筹码了吗？

sentences.en: Yes or no?
sentences.zh: 是还是不是？

sentences.en: Can you say yes or no to that?
sentences.zh: 你能对那个问题回答是或不是吗？

sentences.en: The children are not being used as a pawn.
sentences.zh: 孩子们没有被当作筹码。

sentences.en: We are trying to protect the children, which is why I'm asking Congress to act.
sentences.zh: 我们正在努力保护儿童，这就是我要求国会采取行动的原因。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And then there are people in the middle who may not have had direct contact with the families, but who've been working day in and day out on family separation since it started.
sentences.zh: 还有一些中间人，他们可能没有与这些家庭直接接触，但自家庭拆散开始以来，他们一直在为此日复一日地工作。

sentences.en: And I think disillusionment is the best way to describe what I hear from those people.
sentences.zh: 我认为“幻灭”是描述我从这些人那里听到的感受的最好词汇。

sentences.en: Even the hardliners who supported family separation are frustrated by the haphazard way that it was carried out because it led to what they see now as a lot of wasted time.
sentences.zh: 即使是支持家庭拆散的强硬派也对执行过程中的随意性感到沮丧，因为它导致了他们现在所看到的许多时间的浪费。

sentences.en: And they believe the president backed off of family separation so quickly in the face of public pressure by signing his executive order that it was all for naught.
sentences.zh: 他们认为总统在面对公众压力时，通过签署行政命令如此迅速地放弃了家庭拆散，这一切都白费了。

sentences.en: And not just the work of reunification, but also this fierce public shaming they faced as a result of family separation weren't even worth it in the end, they feel,
sentences.zh: 他们觉得，不仅是团聚的工作，而且他们因家庭拆散而面临的激烈公众羞辱，最终甚至都不值得，

sentences.en: because the policy didn't deter people from crossing the border, didn't even have an effect.
sentences.zh: 因为该政策并没有阻止人们越过边境，甚至没有产生任何影响。

sentences.en: Which was the whole point of family separation in the first place.
sentences.zh: 而这正是当初家庭拆散的全部目的。

sentences.en: Either because word didn't reach Central America fast enough, or people just didn't care, the numbers of people crossing the border are essentially the same.
sentences.zh: 要么是因为消息没有足够快地传到中美洲，要么是人们根本不在乎，越过边境的人数基本相同。

sentences.en: Over all these months since family separation started, nothing has changed.
sentences.zh: 在家庭拆散开始后的这几个月里，什么都没有改变。

sentences.en: At this particular moment in time, come back.
sentences.zh: 在此刻，请回来。

sentences.en: You told the administration that kids would suffer as a result, that pain would be inflected, correct?
sentences.zh: 你曾告诉政府，孩子们会因此受苦，会遭受痛苦，对吗？

sentences.en: So now that it's over, after all of this, politicians, Democrat and Republican,
sentences.zh: 所以现在一切都结束了，经历了这一切之后，无论是民主党还是共和党的政客，

sentences.en: kind of wherever they stand on immigration, they're trying to understand how this could have happened and what the lasting effects might be.
sentences.zh: 无论他们在移民问题上持什么立场，他们都在试图理解这一切是如何发生的，以及可能产生的持久影响。

sentences.en: Separation of children from their parents entails significant risk of harm to children.
sentences.zh: 将儿童与父母分离会对儿童造成严重的伤害风险。

sentences.en: Well, it's traumatic for any child separated from his or her parents.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于任何与父母分离的孩子来说，这都是一种创伤。

sentences.en: Am I correct?
sentences.zh: 我说得对吗？

sentences.en: I say that as a parent of four children?
sentences.zh: 我是以四个孩子的家长的身份说的。

sentences.en: There's no question.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: There's no question that separation of children from parents entails significant potential for traumatic psychological injury to the child.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，将儿童与父母分离会给孩子带来严重的心理创伤风险。

sentences.en: And would I be correct in assuming that the answer to you was, in effect, that's the whole purpose
sentences.zh: 我是否可以认为，你得到的答复实际上是：这正是该政策的全部目的，

sentences.en: of the policy, to inflict pain so as to deter asylum seekers from coming here, correct?
sentences.zh: 即通过施加痛苦来阻止寻求庇护者来到这里，对吗？

sentences.en: No, sir, we were advised that family separation was not the policy.
sentences.zh: 不，先生，我们得到的建议是家庭分离并非政策。

sentences.en: Family separation just happened to result from zero tolerance without anybody knowing in advance, even though you raised the concern, correct?
sentences.zh: 家庭分离只是“零容忍”政策的结果，事先无人知晓，尽管你提出了担忧，对吗？

sentences.en: Yes, we raised concerns about the effect on children as well as the effect on the program.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们确实提出了关于对儿童的影响以及对项目影响的担忧。

sentences.en: So there was awareness that it would be the consequence, correct?
sentences.zh: 所以大家意识到这会是后果，对吗？

sentences.en: You raised it.
sentences.zh: 是你提出来的。

sentences.en: I did raise it.
sentences.zh: 我确实提出来了。

sentences.en: I'm asking again, what was the answer?
sentences.zh: 我再问一遍，当时的答复是什么？

sentences.en: The answer I received is that family separation was not a policy.
sentences.zh: 我收到的答复是，家庭分离并非政策。

sentences.en: I was advised that there was no policy which would result in separation of children from family units.
sentences.zh: 我被告知没有任何政策会导致儿童与家庭成员分离。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I know of one foster mother, she started out with nine children here in New York.

sentences.en: And slowly, one by one, those kids have started going back to their families.

sentences.en: But she still has a couple.
sentences.zh: 但她身边还有几个孩子。

sentences.en: And those are children whose parents have been deemed ineligible for reunification and have been deported.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子的父母已被认定不符合团聚条件，并已被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: And if there's a plan for how they're going to get back to those parents, she says she doesn't know about it.
sentences.zh: 她说，如果有什么让他们回到父母身边的计划，她对此一无所知。

sentences.en: And she says they're pretty much part of the family now.
sentences.zh: 她说他们现在几乎已经是家人了。

sentences.en: And that, for the time being, might actually be the case for a lot of kids whose parents have been deported and whose families haven't figured out how to get them back.
sentences.zh: 而对于许多父母被驱逐出境、家庭又没能想出办法接回他们的孩子来说，这在目前可能确实是现状。

sentences.en: And that is 100% the responsibility of the administration.
sentences.zh: 而这百分之百是政府的责任。

sentences.en: So we really just don't know what's going to happen to those kids.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的不知道这些孩子会怎么样。
